scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:web & npm run dev:a11y & wait
scripts.build: npm run build:a11y && npm run build:web
scripts.build:core: npm --workspace apps/a11y run build:lib && npm --workspace apps/a11y run build:loader && npm --workspace apps/a11y run build:script
scripts.release:core: npm --workspace apps/a11y version patch && npm run build:core && npm --workspace apps/a11y publish --access public
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/a11y && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
